note: Story shapes: how a video's beats are arranged (owner, 2026-10-30: every Short had '4 levels', which felt repetitive; the shapes must keep growing so no cycle forms). A plan names one in `shape` (generator/shapes.py), or invents a new one ({id, name, beats, why}), which ship adds here as `trial`. Every shape keeps the shared spine (generator/story.py): a curiosity hook, the promise early, rising stakes, a turn, a payoff that answers the hook. Only a shape with `levels: true` shows the level chips and a climbing counter. Research adds shapes it sees in top videos (with the reference); the improver promotes trial shapes that beat the median stayed-to-watch / % viewed, and retires ones that keep underperforming. Status: active | trial | retired.

shapes.name: Levels
shapes.when: only when the topic IS a ladder people wait to climb: levels of wealth, $100 to a strap to a pallet to a room, an hour to a decade
shapes.beats: hook -> promise the ladder ('four steps up') -> each level a beat, the counter climbing -> the turn at the top -> the payoff

shapes.name: The reveal (open loop and clues)
shapes.when: how a business really makes money, a secret of the rich, a billionaire question: there is one hidden answer
shapes.beats: hook: the surprising fact and the question, no answer -> promise ('here's how') -> clue one, clue two, clue three, each a bigger piece -> the turn (the piece nobody expects) -> the payoff answers the hook in one line

reference.title: Why does the casino always win, even when nobody cheats? | How Casinos Make Money

shapes.name: Versus
shapes.when: two people or two choices in the same situation, one difference that decides everything
shapes.beats: hook: the same moment, two outcomes -> promise ('one choice decides it') -> side by side: what each does, step by step, the gap widening -> the turn (the real reason) -> the payoff

reference.title: rich vs poor parents buying you a car

shapes.name: Countdown
shapes.when: a handful of things of one kind (tricks, traps, ways): number three, two, then the biggest
shapes.beats: hook: the biggest one teased, not shown -> promise ('three ways, the last is the worst') -> three, two -> the turn -> number one, the payoff

reference.title: 6 Ways Rich People Make Money With Debt

shapes.name: Before and after
shapes.when: one change and what it did: a decision, a law, a company's move, a fortune over time
shapes.beats: hook: the after, shocking, with the question how -> the before, in enough detail to matter -> the change -> what happened step by step -> the turn -> the payoff (the after, explained)

reference.title: Everyone Called Him an Idiot. He Got Richer Every Time.

shapes.name: Then and now
shapes.when: how something changed across years: a price, a fortune, an industry, who was the first billionaire of it
shapes.beats: hook: today's figure next to the old one, and why -> the start -> two or three moments that changed it, in order -> the turn -> today, explained

reference.title: Who Was The 1st Billionaire In These Industries?!

shapes.name: What if
shapes.when: an imagined scenario at a scale people can't picture: spend $1 trillion in a day, pay off the national debt, give everyone a billion
shapes.beats: hook: the wild question -> the rules of the game -> try it, step by step, the number growing -> the turn (where it breaks) -> the payoff (what it teaches)

reference.title: I Tried to Spend $1 TRILLION in One Day
